description: This file provides the implementation of the Graph data structure and related operations in the TensorFlow Go API. It includes functions for creating, importing, exporting, and manipulating computation graphs, as well as defining operations and managing external libraries.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Represents a TensorFlow computation graph with methods for serialization, importing, exporting, and managing operations.

classes.name: GraphImportOptions
classes.description: Holds options for importing a graph definition into a TensorFlow graph, including prefix and device settings, and input mappings.

classes.name: Operation
classes.description: Represents an operation within a TensorFlow graph.

classes.name: Output
classes.description: Represents an output tensor of an operation in the graph.

classes.name: Input
classes.description: Interface for inputs to operations, implemented by Output and OutputList.

classes.name: Tensor
classes.description: Represents a mult-dimensional array (tensor) in TensorFlow.

classes.name: DataType
classes.description: Enumeration of tensor data types (e.g., float32, int64).

classes.name: Shape
classes.description: Represents the shape (dimensions) of a tensor.

classes.name: LibraryHandler
classes.description: Handles a loaded external TensorFlow library containing custom ops.

classes.name: OpSpec
classes.description: Specification for creating a new operation in a graph, including type, inputs, attributes, and device placement.

methods.name: NewGraph
methods.description: Creates and returns a new TensorFlow graph.

methods.name: ImportWithOptions
methods.description: Imports a serialized graph definition into the current graph with specified options.

methods.name: Import
methods.description: Imports a serialized graph definition into the current graph with a prefix for node names.

methods.name: Operation
methods.description: Retrieves an existing operation by name from the graph.

methods.name: Operations
methods.description: Returns a list of all operations in the graph.

methods.name: AddGradients
methods.description: Adds gradient operations to the graph for computing derivatives of outputs w.r.t. inputs.

methods.name: AddOperation
methods.description: Adds a new operation to the graph based on the provided specification.

methods.name: LoadLibrary
methods.description: Loads an external TensorFlow library with custom ops from a specified file path.
